answer: Attestation weight for every wallet arrives on a slow thread - 8 percent across twelve epochs. That hollows the classic ambush: aliases cannot pile up at once for a swing vote. The ledger dates claims when made, not when seen, so a farm must feed a thousand wallets through twelve windows of patience, and claims pre-dating a wallet's funding land with no history behind them. A zephyr batch on a terrace of fresh blocks casts zero; the weight any terrace votes with was decided twelve epochs earlier. Sybil work becomes scheduling work, and scheduling is how clusters get caught.
